name: Gravitational Lens
desc: A foreground galaxy warps spacetime and bends the light of everything behind it into a luminous Einstein ring and stretched giant arcs — a general-relativity light-bending simulation where background galaxies smear into curved crescents around the deflector, the arcs writhing as the source field drifts.

energy.doc: exposure / brightness of the lensed field + ring glow

style.doc: point-ring vs cluster arcs vs dispersion vs schematic critical-curve
